name: Fire Bolt
desc: Hurl a mote of fire. Free to cast.
flavor: A spark leaps from your fingertip and blooms into flame.

name: Ray of Frost
desc: A frigid beam that slows its target. Free to cast.
flavor: Frost crackles along a pale blue beam.

name: Magic Missile
desc: Three glowing darts that never miss.
flavor: Three darts of violet light streak unerringly forward.

name: Shield
desc: +5 AC until your next turn. Bonus action.
flavor: A shimmering pane of force snaps into place.

name: Mage Armor
desc: +3 AC to an ally for the fight. Bonus action.
flavor: Invisible armor hums around them.

name: Sleep
desc: Up to 3 foes fall asleep (stunned 1 turn) unless they resist.
flavor: A drowsy shimmer of sand drifts over the enemy.

name: Burning Hands
desc: A fan of flame scorches up to 3 foes. Blow into the mic to fan it!
flavor: Flames roar from your outspread fingers.

name: Misty Step
desc: Teleport out of danger: attacks against you have disadvantage. Bonus action.
flavor: You vanish in silver mist and reappear a few strides away.

name: Web
desc: Sticky webbing slows and topples up to 3 foes.
flavor: Thick grey strands burst across the battlefield.

name: Invisibility
desc: An ally turns invisible: enemies struggle to hit them, and their next attack has advantage.
flavor: They fade like breath on a cold window.

name: Fireball
desc: The classic. Hold to charge, release at the peak.
flavor: A bead of fire streaks out — and blossoms into a roaring inferno.

name: Counterspell
desc: Unravel an enemy's wind-up attack before it lands, with painful feedback.
flavor: You snap the threads of their power like a cut harp string.

name: Lightning Bolt
desc: A crackling bolt tears through up to 3 foes. Draw the zigzag!
flavor: Thunder splits the air as lightning arcs from your palm.

name: Polymorph
desc: Turn a foe into a sheep for 2 turns (stunned).
flavor: With a pop and a confused 'baa', your enemy becomes livestock.

name: Chain Lightning
desc: Lightning leaps from foe to foe across the whole battlefield.
flavor: The bolt forks, and forks again, and again.

name: Disintegrate
desc: A thin green ray. If it hits, there's not much left.
flavor: A thin green ray — and then a fine grey dust.

name: Sacred Flame
desc: Radiant flame descends on a foe. Free to cast.
flavor: Holy fire falls like sunlight through a cathedral window.

name: Guiding Bolt
desc: A flash of light; the next attack against the target has advantage.
flavor: A bolt of starlight leaves the foe glittering.

name: Cure Wounds
desc: Heal an ally (or yourself) by touch.
flavor: Warm golden light knits flesh back together.

name: Healing Word
desc: A word of power heals from afar — great for picking up downed friends. Bonus action.
flavor: A single spoken syllable rings like a bell.

name: Bless
desc: All allies add 1d4 to attacks and saves for 3 turns.
flavor: A soft chorus only the faithful can hear.

name: Sanctuary
desc: Enemies must pass a WIS save to attack the warded ally. Bonus action.
flavor: A ring of pale light settles around them.

name: Spiritual Weapon
desc: A floating spectral hammer strikes a foe at the start of each of your turns. Bonus action.
flavor: A hammer of light appears and swings on its own.

name: Hold Person
desc: Paralyze a foe for 2 turns.
flavor: Their limbs lock as if bound by invisible chains.

name: Turn Undead
desc: Present your holy symbol and shout: all foes are frightened and seared. Undead take double.
flavor: 'BEGONE!' Your symbol flares like a second sun.

name: Preserve Life
desc: Channel divinity to heal the whole party.
flavor: Green-gold light washes over every ally.

name: Revivify
desc: Bring a downed or freshly dead ally back to their feet.
flavor: A gasp, a cough, a heartbeat.

name: Spirit Guardians
desc: Spectral guardians sear every enemy at the start of your turns.
flavor: Winged spirits circle you, blades of light drawn.

name: Daylight
desc: Blinding light: all foes blinded for a turn. Undead hate it.
flavor: Noon arrives, suddenly and everywhere.

name: Mass Healing Word
desc: Heal the whole party with a single word. Bonus action.
flavor: Your voice carries, and wounds close.

name: Banishment
desc: Send a foe to another plane for 3 turns.
flavor: With a thunderclap, they are simply elsewhere.

name: Flame Strike
desc: A column of divine fire crashes down on up to 2 foes.
flavor: The sky opens and pours out fire.

name: Heal
desc: A massive heal that also cures every condition.
flavor: Light floods them; every wound and curse is undone.

name: Vicious Mockery
desc: Insult a foe so cruelly it hurts. Shout it! Free to cast.
flavor: Your words cut deeper than any blade.

name: Bardic Inspiration
desc: An ally adds 1d6 to their next d20 roll. Tap to the beat! Bonus action.
flavor: A rousing verse just for them.

name: Charm Person
desc: Charm a foe so they won't attack (breaks if they take damage).
flavor: Suddenly, you seem like an old, dear friend.

name: Thunderwave
desc: A wave of thunder knocks up to 2 foes flat. Shake your phone!
flavor: BOOM. Everything nearby goes flying.

name: Dissonant Whispers
desc: A discordant melody only the target hears.
flavor: A tune so wrong it makes their teeth ache.

name: Song of Rest
desc: Party heals an extra 1d6 + your level on short rests.
flavor: A lullaby by the campfire.

name: Shatter
desc: A piercing note rips through up to 2 foes. Hit the high note!
flavor: Glass, stone and bone all ring and crack.

name: Cutting Words
desc: Heckle a foe mid-wind-up, cancelling its big attack. Bonus action.
flavor: 'Nice swing. Did your mother teach you that?'

name: Hypnotic Pattern
desc: A swirl of colors entrances every foe.
flavor: Twisting ribbons of color hang in the air.

name: Song of Courage
desc: Clear fear and charm from all allies and bless them.
flavor: A marching tune that straightens every spine.

name: Greater Invisibility
desc: Invisibility that doesn't break when you attack.
flavor: Gone — but still very much here.

name: Irresistible Jig
desc: A foe dances helplessly for 3 turns.
flavor: Their feet start tapping. They can't stop.

name: Power Word Stun
desc: Speak a word that stuns a foe, no save.
flavor: A word that is mostly consonants and pure will.

name: Ballad of Heroes
desc: Heal and inspire the entire party.
flavor: The song they'll sing about you, sung by you.

name: Divine Smite
desc: Your next weapon hit deals extra radiant damage (double vs undead). Bonus action.
flavor: Your blade blazes with holy light.

name: Lay on Hands
desc: A healing touch that also cures poison. Hold to pray.
flavor: Your palms glow warm and gold.

name: Shield of Faith
desc: +2 AC to an ally for 5 turns. Bonus action.
flavor: A shimmering ward settles over them.

name: Wrathful Smite
desc: Your next hit also frightens the target. Bonus action.
flavor: Your wrath becomes a weapon.

name: Compelled Duel
desc: Force enemies to fight you instead of your friends. Bonus action.
flavor: 'Face ME!'

name: Thunderous Smite
desc: Your next hit booms with thunder and knocks the target prone. Bonus action.
flavor: Your weapon rings like a struck bell.

name: Sacred Weapon
desc: +3 to hit and +1d4 radiant on weapon attacks for 5 turns. Bonus action.
flavor: Your weapon shines with your oath.

name: Branding Smite
desc: Your next hit sears and blinds. Bonus action.
flavor: A glowing brand burns onto your foe.

name: Aura of Protection
desc: All allies add +2 to saving throws while you stand.
flavor: Your conviction shelters your friends.

name: Aura of Courage
desc: Allies can't be frightened while you stand.
flavor: Fear finds no purchase near you.

name: Crusader's Mantle
desc: All allies' weapon attacks deal +1d4 radiant for 3 turns.
flavor: A holy banner of light unfurls above you.

name: Banishing Smite
desc: Your next hit deals massive force damage and stuns. Bonus action.
flavor: Strike them clean out of this world.

name: Avenging Angel
desc: Sprout radiant wings: extra attacks and radiant fury for 3 turns. Bonus action.
flavor: Wings of light unfold behind you.

name: Sneak Attack
desc: Once per turn, a weapon hit deals extra d6s (½ your level, rounded up) if you have advantage, the foe has a condition, or an ally is standing.
flavor: You find the gap in their guard.

name: Cunning Action
desc: Dash, dodge and duck: attacks against you have disadvantage until your next turn. Bonus action.
flavor: Now you see me...

name: Backstab
desc: Sneak up silently (stay quiet!) and strike for extra damage.
flavor: They never hear you coming.

name: Poison Blade
desc: Coat your blade: next hit deals poison damage and poisons the target. Bonus action.
flavor: A drop of something green, carefully applied.

name: Pickpocket
desc: Lift a purse mid-fight. Two-finger the pouch without fumbling!
flavor: Light fingers, heavy pockets.

name: Smoke Bomb
desc: Choking smoke blinds all foes. Shake to throw!
flavor: A pop, a hiss, and a wall of grey.

name: Trick Shot
desc: A ricochet shot that topples the target. Hold steady to aim.
flavor: Off the wall, off the lamp, into the knee.

name: Caltrops
desc: Scatter spikes that slow up to 3 foes.
flavor: Mind your step.

name: Evasion
desc: DEX saves: take no damage on success and half on failure.
flavor: You're simply not where the fireball is.

name: Uncanny Dodge
desc: Halve all damage you take until your next turn. Bonus action.
flavor: You roll with every blow.

name: Vanish
desc: Get the whole party out of a non-boss fight. Stay silent!
flavor: When the smoke clears, you're all gone.

name: Assassinate
desc: A killing strike that crits on 18+.
flavor: One breath. One blade.

name: Shadow Step
desc: Melt into shadow: become invisible. Bonus action.
flavor: The shadows open like a door.

name: Death Mark
desc: Mark a foe: all attacks against it deal +6 damage and have advantage. Bonus action.
flavor: You've seen exactly where to cut.

name: Blade Flurry
desc: Strike up to 3 foes in a whirl of steel.
flavor: Blades everywhere, all at once.

name: Rage
desc: Bellow a battle cry! +2 melee damage and half physical damage taken. Bonus action.
flavor: Your vision goes red at the edges.

name: Reckless Attack
desc: Swing with abandon: attack with advantage, but foes get advantage on you until your next turn. Swing your phone!
flavor: Defense is for people with less muscle.

name: Headbutt
desc: Once per fight: a hit that may stun (CON save).
flavor: CLONK.

name: Unarmored Defense
desc: Without armor, your AC is 10 + DEX + CON.
flavor: Who needs armor?

name: Danger Sense
desc: Advantage on DEX saves against telegraphed attacks and traps.
flavor: You smell trouble before it arrives.

name: Cleave
desc: One huge swing hits two foes.
flavor: A wide, whistling arc.

name: Intimidating Roar
desc: ROAR! Frighten every foe. Once per fight, bonus action.
flavor: Birds flee the trees for a mile around.

name: Savage Leap
desc: Leap onto a foe, knocking them flat. Aim your landing!
flavor: From above, with feeling.

name: Frenzy
desc: An extra wild attack as a bonus action (twice per fight).
flavor: Again! AGAIN!

name: Whirlwind
desc: Spin and strike every foe. Shake it!
flavor: A spinning storm of steel.

name: Mighty Throw
desc: Hurl a boulder (or a table, or a goblin) at a distant foe.
flavor: Whatever's heaviest and closest.

name: Ground Slam
desc: Smash the earth: damage and knock down all foes.
flavor: The ground buckles like a wave.

name: Brutal Critical
desc: Critical hits roll two extra weapon dice.
flavor: When you hit hard, you hit HARD.

name: Relentless Rage
desc: While raging, dropping to 0 HP leaves you at 1 HP instead (once per fight).
flavor: Not today.

name: Primal Champion
desc: +2 STR and +2 CON.
flavor: You are a force of nature.

name: Second Wind
desc: Catch your breath and heal. Hold steady. Bonus action.
flavor: Deep breath. Back in it.

name: Action Surge
desc: Take an extra action this turn. Bonus action.
flavor: A burst of impossible speed.

name: Shield Bash
desc: Bash a foe: interrupts its wind-up and may stun. Swing!
flavor: Steel meets face.

name: Precision Strike
desc: A carefully placed blow: +5 to hit and +1d8 damage.
flavor: You see the opening and take it.

name: Taunt
desc: Shout a challenge: enemies must attack you, and you gain +2 AC. Bonus action.
flavor: 'Hey! Ugly! Over here!'

name: Defensive Stance
desc: +3 AC until your next turn. Bonus action.
flavor: Feet planted, shield up.

name: Disarm
desc: Knock their weapon away: -4 to their attacks and cancels a wind-up.
flavor: A twist of the wrist and their sword goes spinning.

name: Riposte
desc: Any foe that attacks you takes a counter-strike. Bonus action.
flavor: Parry. Thrust.

name: Trip Attack
desc: Sweep their legs: damage and knock prone.
flavor: Down you go.

name: Volley
desc: Loose a hail of arrows at up to 3 foes. Aim with your phone!
flavor: The sky darkens with arrows.

name: Extra Attack
desc: Your basic Attack strikes twice.
flavor: One-two.

name: Improved Critical
desc: Your weapon attacks crit on 19–20.
flavor: You know exactly where it hurts.

name: Rally
desc: A rallying cry grants temporary HP to the whole party. Bonus action.
flavor: 'Stand fast! Hold the line!'

name: Indomitable
desc: +3 to all saving throws.
flavor: Unshakeable.

name: Blade Storm
desc: Strike every foe on the field.
flavor: You become a whirlwind of discipline.

name: Unbreakable
desc: Massive temporary HP and half damage for 2 turns. Bonus action.
flavor: Mountains don't fall over.

name: Breath Weapon
desc: Exhale your ancestry's element on up to 3 foes. Blow into the mic! Once per fight.
flavor: Your ancestors' fury pours out of your lungs.

name: Aggressive Charge
desc: Charge with a roar: your next hit deals +1d6. Once per fight, bonus action.
flavor: You lower your head and CHARGE.
